scenarios.title: Norwegian check: does the model reproduce a real hospital?
scenarios.description: 100 early-stage lung cancer patients at one Norwegian centre (Stokstad et al. 2019), rebuilt step by step. Calibrated on the observed pathway only; everything else is a prediction.

variants.label: Suggested change (found without seeing the authors' answer)
changes: Use the faster PET-CT scanner (the same assumption the authors made)
Diagnostic workup complete: don't wait for sampling finished (it runs in parallel; treatment still waits for it)
When PET-CT is ordered: always pet-ct ordered at triage or at the first visit
When the exercise test is ordered: always exercise test
Tissue sampling planned?: order it at the same time as first hospital visit, not after

variants.label: Suggested change without any new equipment
